name: Automated Job Finder - Fresher Tech Jobs to Telegram

nodes.name: Every 1 Minute
nodes.notes: Starts the job search every minute. Each source has its own pollEveryMinutes setting in Job Sources Config, so big boards are polled less often.

nodes.name: Job Sources Config
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: list of company career boards (official public Greenhouse / Lever / Ashby APIs) plus Adzuna India searches. Add a source by adding one line. Outputs only the sources due this minute.

nodes.name: Needs API Key?
nodes.notes: Routes Adzuna searches to the authenticated request; all other boards use the open public request (no keys sent to them).

nodes.name: Fetch Adzuna Jobs
nodes.notes: Official Adzuna India search API (app_id + app_key come from the credential). On error it outputs an error item that is skipped, so other sources still run.

nodes.name: Normalize & Filter Role/Location
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: role keywords, excluded seniority words and target cities. Converts every source to one job format and keeps target roles in Hyderabad / Bangalore / Chennai / Remote India.

nodes.name: Skip Already Seen Jobs
nodes.notes: Keeps only jobs whose application URL is not yet in the job_finder_seen_jobs data table (the URL is the unique ID).

nodes.name: Needs Job Details?
nodes.notes: Greenhouse list responses contain no description, so the full posting is fetched only for new jobs (keeps each run light).

nodes.name: Fetch Job Description
nodes.notes: Gets the full description from the public Greenhouse job endpoint. Errors are tolerated.

nodes.name: Attach Description
nodes.notes: Merges the fetched description back into the job record.

nodes.name: Check Experience & Build Message
nodes.notes: Reads the description for experience requirements (rejects >1 year), extracts a short summary and builds the Telegram message.

nodes.name: Is Matching Job?
nodes.notes: True = 0-1 year job, send it. False = needs more experience, only remember it so it is not re-checked.

nodes.name: Remember Sent Job
nodes.notes: Stores the URL of every matching job so it is never sent twice.

nodes.name: Get Active Subscribers
nodes.notes: Loads everyone who sent /start to the bot and has not sent /stop. One output item per subscriber for each job.

nodes.name: Send Job to Telegram
nodes.notes: Sends each new matching job to every active subscriber. A failed send (e.g. a user blocked the bot) is skipped so other subscribers still get the job.

nodes.name: Remember Rejected Job
nodes.notes: Stores jobs rejected for experience so their descriptions are not fetched again every minute.

nodes.name: Fetch Public Job Feeds
nodes.notes: Calls each public job-board API once (no login, no scraping). On error/timeout it outputs an error item that is skipped later, so other sources still run.

nodes.name: Telegram Bot Messages
nodes.notes: Receives every message anyone sends to the bot (/start, /stop, anything else).

nodes.name: Subscribe User
nodes.notes: Adds the chat to the subscriber list (or re-activates it).

parameters.text:
=Hi {{ $('Telegram Bot Messages').item.json.message.from.first_name || "there" }}! You are subscribed. New fresher (0-1 year) tech jobs in Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai and Remote India will be sent here as soon as they are found.

Send /stop anytime to unsubscribe.

nodes.name: Unsubscribe User
nodes.notes: Marks the chat inactive so it stops receiving jobs.

parameters.text: You are unsubscribed and will not get job alerts anymore. Send /start to subscribe again.
Send /start to get fresher tech job alerts, or /stop to unsubscribe.

nodeGroups.name: Collect job postings
nodeGroups.description: Polls the career boards and Adzuna searches due this minute, keeps target roles in Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai or Remote India

nodeGroups.name: Screen new jobs
nodeGroups.description: Ignores URLs already handled, pulls missing descriptions, rejects roles needing over 1 year and drafts the alert text

nodeGroups.name: Deliver new matches
nodeGroups.description: Sends each 0-1 year job to every subscriber on Telegram and records handled URLs so nothing is sent or re-checked twice

nodeGroups.name: Manage subscribers
nodeGroups.description: Anyone messaging the bot: /start joins the alert list with a welcome, /stop leaves it, anything else gets help
